text:
elaine: Heads-up — customer reported a function hook returning a stringified JSON instead of an object; validator flagged hard reject. Quick sync on telemetry + console annotations?
raj: Oh no, the stringified payload pattern again :grimacing: Which hook?
noah: search_v1. Example from logs: 
```
{"tool_response": "{\"result\": \"ok\"}", "hook_id": "search_v1"}
```
Validator sees type=string vs expected object and emits STRUCT_MISMATCH.
sanjay: Current reject event has code=STRUCT_MISMATCH and almost no context. We should tag whether it was parseable (coercible) and whether it looks like adapter bug vs model hallucination.
amanda: For console, propose annotations: error_reason, attempted_coercion, original_raw_ref, redaction_hint. Default to hiding raw payloads for PII safety.
elaine: Proposed telemetry fields:
- error_reason: "STRUCT_MISMATCH" | "PARSE_ERROR" | "EXTRA_FIELDS"
- attempted_coercion: "true" | "false"
- coercion_strategy: "parse_json" | "regex_salvage" | "none"
- display_hint: "redact" | "preview" | "full"
raj: Also need dashboard metric: validation_rejects_by_reason (labels: hook_id, region, sample_rate). Useful to triage adapter vs model regressions.
noah: Important: don't save original_raw in hot telemetry. Emit trace_id + short blob_hash that maps to encrypted artifact store. Keeping originals in main DB = compliance nightmare.
sanjay: ops-bot: do we have secure artifact flow?
ops-bot: Yes — trace artifacts post to s3-retain-encrypted with restricted audit-only IAM access. Attach trace_id to telemetry as reference.
amanda: Console UX idea: compact row = [Reject badge] reason | coercion badge | "Open sample" (restricted link). "Show raw" should be behind a two-step confirm and RBAC.
elaine: Billing question: If request fails validation and we route to fallback, what is billable? We currently count upstream tokens even if tooling failed.
raj: Product perspective: customers will push back on being charged for fail-fast rejects. Infra processed tokens though. Possible compromise: bill ingress tokens only, mark final generation tokens as zero when validation_reject triggers. Requires ledger/metric changes.
noah: We already tag meter_tag=validation_reject. Can add meter_bucket=ingress_only and emit separate cost events. Ledger PR needed.
sanjay: Rollout plan: add telemetry + console preview behind FF. Start 1% internal canary, expand to 10% opt-in beta customers.
amanda: Console wireframe: badge, reason, coercion icon (hover shows strategy), "Open sample" link, "Create support ticket" CTA prefilled with trace_id.
elaine: Short-term mitigation: if validator sees a string that JSON-parses to expected schema, mark attempted_coercion=true and route to success pipeline while incrementing coercion_metric. This reduces visible rejects while adapters are fixed. Must surface coerced responses in dashboards.
raj: OK as temporary grace, but coerced=false/true must be clearly labeled so teams can track quality impact.
noah: Add metric: coerced_vs_accepted_by_hook with label coerced=true/false and hook_id.
sanjay: Add alert: when validation_rejects_by_hook > 5x baseline over 10m for production customers, page oncall and create incident stub.
amanda: I'll post mockups in ~3h. Could also add a toggle to filter console list to only show coerced or hard rejects.
elaine: I'll draft a short RFC covering telemetry schema, storage/trace plan, billing implications, and rollout steps. Tagging @raj and @noah as owners.
raj: I'll take validator changes and telemetry emitters (coercion-first opt-in).
noah: I'll wire artifact trace storage and submit ledger change PRs.
sanjay: I'll add alerting rules and sampling toggles in ops playbook.
amanda: Mockups incoming later today.
ops-bot: Action created: #5532110000 — RFC + telemetry PRs. Assignees: raj, noah, sanjay; due 2026-03-27.
elaine: If you hit a live customer case, paste trace_id here and we'll prioritize. Thanks :thumbsup:
raj: Will do.
